_note: Free-play start. When enabled (and no mission boot / no test harness flags), the player starts at 'start' (a key from InteriorSpots.json) on an open, flat patch of street found automatically near that spot, facing a lineup of 'vehicles' (ids from Vehicles.json). All weapons are unlocked. -BRSandbox[=spot] forces it on, -BRNoSandbox turns it off.
